gates.description: Training pipeline must be automated, version-controlled, and reproducible from same data+code
Feature computation must be consistent between training and serving (feature store or shared code)
Models must be versioned in a model registry with promotion workflow
Rollback procedure to previous model version must be documented and tested
Data drift and prediction drift monitoring must be configured with alert thresholds
Serving latency SLA must be defined and load tested under production traffic

anti_patterns.description: Deploying the Jupyter notebook as the production system — global variables, hardcoded paths, no error handling
Features computed differently in training vs serving — model works offline, fails in production
A model deployed once, never retrained, never monitored — deployed 18 months ago and forgotten
Training jobs on expensive GPU instances at 10% utilization, serving endpoints idle 90% of the time
Every model served as real-time API even when predictions are consumed in batch

escalation_triggers: Model serving latency exceeds SLA and optimization options are exhausted
Significant data drift detected with no clear retraining path
Training pipeline costs growing significantly faster than model improvements
Model bias detected in production affecting user fairness
Infrastructure limitations preventing model deployment (GPU availability, memory constraints)
Model performance degradation that retraining does not fix — concept drift requiring model redesign

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with model serving requirements and latency SLAs

output_certifications: Training pipeline automated, version-controlled, and reproducible
Feature computation consistent between training and serving (no training-serving skew)
Models versioned in model registry with promotion workflow
Rollback procedure to previous model version documented and tested
Drift monitoring configured (data drift, prediction drift) with alert thresholds
Serving latency SLA defined and validated under production traffic
